items.title: 67426_Hayes Pillars oral history interview
items.q: And was that fellow named Green? ... Benny Green. That was the band.

ctx.x: And the girl playing trombone, too, that came in here, that came in here with Redd Foxx? [Melba Liston]-ed
She played trombone, nice trombone. And was that fellow named Green?
